task: Stop deleting triggered assistant conversations on httpx.HTTPError; persist sanitized ERROR turn for transport failures; call _save_error before re-raising MCPAuthenticationRequiredException and BrokerAuthRequiredException in _ask_assistant.

key_reasoning.reason: Sanitization is the primary risk: httpx.HTTPStatusError embeds full internal URLs (BASE_API_URL) and MCPAuthenticationRequiredException payloads contain MCP server config details — both must be stripped to allowlisted fields before passing to _save_error. Transport-layer errors (ConnectError, TimeoutException) bypass the router entirely, requiring the actor to synthesize an ExtendedHTTPException itself with no existing actor-side history helper. Existing sanitizer patterns (_sanitize_url_for_log) exist but must be applied carefully. Bumped from M(3) to L(4) by 'affects authentication or authorization' red flag.

Three layers touched: Trigger/Transport actor (triggers/actors/assistant.py), REST API Orchestration (_ask_assistant in routers/assistant.py), and the shared chat history persistence path (_save_error + ChatHistoryData). The exception layer (core/exceptions.py) may also be touched to expose allowlisted fields. Coordination across actor and router is required but the pattern is well-understood.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M(3) to L(4): task touches authentication/authorization exception paths (MCPAuthenticationRequiredException, BrokerAuthRequiredException) and requires sanitization discipline to prevent token/credential leakage into persisted chat history.
